items.title: Tigers Host Temple Friday Night on Senior Day
items.summary: MEMPHIS, Tenn. – The University of Memphis (8-3, 5-2 American) football team will close out the regular season slate inside Simmons Bank Liberty Stadium, hosting Temple (2-9, 1-6 American) on Friday, Nov. 27, with pregame festivities for Memphis' 24 seniors being honored.

items.title: Winners and losers: Navy beats Memphis on last-second touchdown, Carter has big game
items.summary: The Memphis Tigers lost to the Navy Midshipmen 38-34 to fall to 8-3 on the season. Navy scored a go-ahead touchdown with 15 seconds left to hand the Tigers its second conference loss this season. Here is a look at winners and losers from the game.

items.title: No. 24 Tigers Fall to Navy in Final Seconds

items.title: Winners and losers: Memphis offense puts up 52, defense struggles in thrilling win
items.summary: The Tigers went up 21-0 in the first quarter, but a long field goal miss swung the momentum, and USF dominated Memphis' defense from that point on. Luckily for Memphis, the offense kept up, and the defense made a couple of timely stops at the end to escape with the win.
